$description: Who may do what. Two kinds of player — citizens, the crowd who invest as widely as they can, and coop founders, who launch coops that generate income — plus the admin. A role is a bundle of capabilities and may inherit another's; the API checks capabilities, never role names, so a new role is a row here and no change to any route.

citizen.$description: Every player. Mints their income, founds or joins one city for good, launches coops inside it and backs them, holds MINDS.

founder.$description: Launches and runs coops, and sees the makers' board: the intents. In the real world this role comes with a cost; here it is granted by the admin.

admin.$description: The first citizen to sign up. Promotes citizens to founders and back, for now by hand.
